network_enforcement: The release checker invokes the existing validation recipe, whose four Lean elaborations run through bubblewrap --unshare-net. It makes no network request and does not mutate .lake. Reusing the shared warm pinned cache is explicitly nonrelease evidence, not a cold hermetic build.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact five-line PASS/BLOCKED negative release reconciliation summary

scope_boundary: Worker-side negative release reconciliation plus replay of the existing network-denied warm-cache validation recipe. The checker validates the exact blocked verdict and two partial obligations; it does not supply canonical-root closure, accepted H0/R0, immutable clean input, a cold empty-cache or offline build, complete provenance/TCB/SBOM closure, distinct signed runners, an independently implemented verifier, a deterministic release bundle, or master acceptance.
